origin: Local diagnostic rules; not acceptance limits supplied by the upstream repositories

trs_onset_coverage.denominator: All channels of each saved multichannel record, including abstentions
trs_onset_coverage.interpretation: Availability of exploratory onsets, not pick accuracy or acquisition quality

masw_support.interpretation: Geometric candidate support c > 2*f*dx; no modal validation implied

overall: Worst evaluated dimension; any unresolved mandatory dimension prevents GREEN
missing_evidence: GRAY; never silently converted to GREEN
